items.description: the stock filing form is rendered at its route when App is mounted in MemoryRouter at /stock/file
the stock filing form renders its sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code inputs plus submit control each carrying their data-testid seam

POSTing a new stock record with a per-run-unique sku+location pair, a quantity, and an inventory_code to the API boundary returns a success response and the record is durably persisted on the real branch DB
the boundary module (app/routes/) contains no import of the SQLAlchemy DB session
the service module (app/services/) contains no SQLAlchemy ORM or session import
the boundary module (app/routes/) contains no direct import of any ORM model class
DATABASE_URL is read from the environment and no hardcoded database connection string exists in application source code
the integration test suite connects via a real DATABASE_URL to the paired branch database and no in-memory or mocked database driver is present in the test configuration
inserting a stock_records row with a null quantity value is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database
the stock service raises a validation error and issues no database write when the submitted quantity is negative
a direct INSERT into stock_records with a negative quantity value is rejected by the ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative CHECK constraint on the real branch database
a boundary validation error response for a malformed file-stock request identifies the specific invalid field by name in the error payload
submitting the stock filing form dispatches a POST request to the stock API endpoint with the entered sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code values
the Alembic stock_records migration completes a single-step downgrade followed by upgrade against the real branch database without error
rows seeded with per-run-unique keys into stock_records before the migration upgrade are retrievable from the real branch database with all expected column values intact after the upgrade
GETting a previously filed stock record from the API boundary returns the exact quantity and inventory_code that were stored
the stock boundary retrieval endpoint returns a JSON response body and no server-side template rendering exists in app/routes/
the stock record detail view displays the retrieved quantity value after a successful read-back
the stock record detail view displays the retrieved inventory_code value after a successful read-back
POSTing a second stock record for the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair updates the existing record in place and returns a success response with no error surfaced
no error element is displayed in the stock filing form after a repeat submission for the same (sku, location) pair succeeds via upsert
filing a stock record twice with the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair produces exactly one row in stock_records on the real branch database
two concurrent upserts for the same per-run-unique (sku, location) pair produce exactly one row in stock_records with no error on the real branch database
an in-place upsert on an existing (sku, location) row does not alter the original created_at timestamp value on the real branch database
